name: clip5_hyjal_summit
objective: Are you ready for December 9? Sources: Blizzard raid overview, Warcraft Wiki, Icy Veins.
pages: Level 60, together with Barrow Deeps and Onyxia's Lair.
The biggest of the new raids. Forever raids don't scale, so plan for exactly 20 (per Icy Veins).
All WoW: Forever raids are currently planned to reset weekly.
The summit of Mount Hyjal, near the World Tree Nordrassil.
The raid opens with a battle against an ancient guardian.
Paths cross the mountain through ruins above and below ground.
Clear the forces threatening Hyjal to open the way to the final encounters.
Bandalar, Time-Lost Battalion, Old Gloomlurker, Kathris the Haunted, Elder Minderel, Council of Thorns (Warcraft Wiki).
Nythus the Dreambound, per Warcraft Wiki.
Icy Veins reports Forever's first legendary is tied to Hyjal Summit.
Defeat all 13 bosses for 1 account-wide Legacy point.
